1.title: Trump says ceasefire is 'over' after US and Iran trade strikes
1.summary: Speaking ahead of a Nato summit, the president says US negotiators can keep talking with the Iranians "if they want".

2.title: Family of Man Fatally Shot by ICE Agent Calls for Independent Inquiry
2.summary: The man killed, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, was mourned by his sons as a father, husband and business owner, and said he was shot inside his car. Details of the encounter remain unclear.

3.title: Navy Identifies Crew Member Lost in Arabian Sea Helicopter Crash
3.summary: Cmdr. Gabriel Edwards was declared missing after what the Navy said was an emergency water landing during a routine patrol.

4.title: Live Updates: Trump Praises NATO’s ‘Unity’ After Lashing Out at Allies
4.summary: Though President Trump assailed partners for not joining the war in Iran, he said he would grant Ukraine long-sought authority to make the Patriot defense system.

5.title: Iran Live Updates: Trump Casts Doubt on Future of Cease-Fire After Latest Strikes
5.summary: “I think it’s over,” President Trump said, referring to the preliminary truce, and threatened to strike Iran again. The two sides traded attacks as their truce appeared to edge closer to collapse.
